why: Y tells the viewer where and what within a second, and X shows a nice map with an unlabeled number in an unidentified place.
top_fix_for_weaker: Add a place label (country or city) and a caption saying what the $107 is (for example 'GDP per capita, 1962'). Draw the route as a visible line, zoom in so the subject fills the frame instead of empty ocean, and make the callout text larger.
